scientific_integrity: The achiral \(r=d/2\) isotropy crossing and known covariance formulas are credited to earlier work. The new comparison concerns chirality breaking that degeneracy; complete publication priority requires independent investigation.
scientific_limitations: Absolute heading resets, independent Poisson waiting times, positive rotational diffusivity, uniform intrinsic angular drift, isotropic thermal noise; the avoided crossing is a local asymptotic statement, not a global reset-rate minimum.
title: Chirality avoids the diffusion-isotropy crossing of an orientationally reset swimmer
